newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian teachers block traffic in pay protest.
newsitem.headline: Russian teachers block traffic in pay protest.

text.p: More than a hundred frustrated teachers blocked traffic on a major highway in southern Russia on Thursday, linking arms across the road to protest against unpaid wages, Itar-Tass news agency said.
The teachers, from the town of Volzhsky near Volgograd, have not been paid for five months and have not received child allowances and other state benefits for a year, Tass said.
Tass said they also protested outside Volzhsky town hall against what they saw as mayor Anatoly Shiryayev's betrayal of their interests. Shiryayev, a communist, is a former teacher.

President Boris Yeltsin has said chronic delays in payment of wages and pensions are the most pressing problem facing Russia and has called on his newly reshuffled government to take urgent measures to pay off the arrears.
Many teachers joined a nationwide day of protests last month to complain about the wage and pension delays.
